displayName: MiniMax H3 Max Image to Video
description: MiniMax H3 Max animating a still, up to 15 seconds. Give it one image for a start frame, or two to animate from the first to the last.

pricing.note: fal publishes this per second of output video: $0.025 at 480P and $0.04 at 768P. Those are promotional launch rates and fal's own page says the discount ends September 1 2026, after which 480P is $0.05 and 768P is $0.08. Revisit then. genmedia reports $0.00017 per compute second for this endpoint, which is not what a request is charged: an earlier version of this file took that row for the price and resold the model at $0.00021 per second, roughly a two hundredth of its cost. The published prose is the authority here, and this note exists so the waiver in catalog-check does not hide the same mistake twice.
